sources.title: Límites y Unidades Administrativas Actuales · CNIG
sources.spatial_role: authoritative cross-check for Gipuzkoa provincial boundary; nationwide package may be large
known_limitations: Catalogue lists a nationwide Shapefile package of 156.96 MB; do not download until the exact distribution link and filtering workflow are confirmed.
Metadata lists ETRS89 coordinates; inspect the actual file CRS and administrative code fields before filtering.
Use this source to verify the territorial boundary, not as terrain or vegetation data.
sources.license: Compatible with CC-BY 4.0 under the product's stated conditions

sources.title: Límites municipales oficiales de Gipuzkoa
sources.spatial_role: official municipality boundaries to dissolve into Gipuzkoa pilot boundary
known_limitations: Portal terms say geographic information is informative and users should verify currency and accuracy against the corresponding official administrative sources.
Inspect CRS, geometry validity, multipart features and enclaves before dissolve.
Retain municipal features and municipality attributes in addition to the dissolved pilot outline.
sources.license: CC BY 4.0; attribution required and link to b5m.gipuzkoa.eus

sources.title: Modelo Digital de Elevaciones (1 metro) del País Vasco
sources.format: GeoTIFF or service tiles; confirm per distribution
sources.reference_date: 2008-2017 with later change updates described in metadata
known_limitations: Inspect per-tile lineage and dates; page offers historical and maximum-current distributions.
Verify vertical datum and tile completeness before processing.
sources.license: Reuse permitted with attribution per dataset metadata

sources.title: MDT50cm provisional V1 · 3rd PNOA-LiDAR coverage
sources.format: MDT GeoTIFF (distribution to resolve by tile)
known_limitations: Provisional V1 generated from initial point-cloud classification NPC01.
Do not assume 0.5 m effective accuracy or completeness from pixel size alone.

sources.title: Mapa Forestal CAE 2024 · distribución SHP
sources.spatial_role: vegetation and forest-structure context; not a fire-behaviour fuel model
known_limitations: Minimum homogeneous polygon stated as 0.10 ha.
Do not translate classes to fuel models without a reviewed crosswalk.
Confirm field schema and coverage after download.
sources.license: Reuse permitted with attribution per official catalogue

sources.title: Mapa Forestal CAE 2025 · tablas estadísticas
sources.spatial_role: territorial/comarcal statistics and currency check; not a spatial raster/vector layer
known_limitations: The inspected page exposes tables including Gipuzkoa; a downloadable 2025 spatial dataset was not confirmed.

sources.title: MDT LiDAR 2017 · 1 m · teselas individuales
sources.format: ZIP por tesela; directorios de hojas Hxxxx
sources.reference_date: 2017 terrain model; maximum-current package directory dated 2020-04-22
sources.spatial_role: primary 1 m terrain candidate for Gipuzkoa after per-tile lineage review
known_limitations: Do not download the statewide 1 m multipart archive (15 parts, approximately 15 GB); use individual ZIPs from the tile directories after a spatial tile index is built.
The current distribution includes change updates, but its base LiDAR acquisition and change lineage must be checked per tile.
Verify vertical datum EGM08_REDNAP and raster NoData/edge coverage.
sources.license: Reuse permitted with attribution per dataset metadata
